fields.Name: Skip ICF - Certification Status Mix
fields.Description: MoreCheese: Member Certifications grouped by certification and status (Awarded / InProgress / Expired).

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me a stacked bar chart of member certifications by certification name, split by status (awarded, in progress, expired). When I click a bar segment, show me the members in that certification and status. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a stacked (or grouped) bar chart with one bar per certification
Uses MoreCheese: Member Certifications joined to MoreCheese: Certifications
Status split includes Awarded, InProgress and Expired
Totals are consistent with the data: about 123 member certifications; Cheese Foundations Certificate is the largest (about 48)
Clicking a segment shows a table of the members holding that certification with that status, with award/expiry dates
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
